title: Cannabis 101 | BUZZY
description: A beginner's guide to shopping for cannabis at BUZZY, assembled from BUZZY's own articles.
lede: New to cannabis, or coming back after a break? Start here, in BUZZY's own words.

blocks.html: A first trip to a dispensary starts with a few questions. This is how BUZZY puts it.
Think of this as your friendly neighborhood guide to stepping into the world of cannabis with confidence.
blocks.sourceTitle: Your First Cannabis Purchase: Buzzy’s Guide to Feeling Confident, Curious & Completely At Ease

blocks.html: A good licensed dispensary should make cannabis easier to understand, not turn it into a test.
blocks.sourceTitle: Your First Time at a Brooklyn Dispensary: What to Expect

blocks.html: At BUZZY, we built the experience around curation rather than overload. If it is your first visit, tell us.
blocks.sourceTitle: Your First Time at a Brooklyn Dispensary: What to Expect

blocks.html: Cannabis comes in several formats. Here are the most common ones.

Flower is loose cannabis intended to be smoked or vaporized with appropriate equipment. Pre-rolls are ready-made joints and may be infused or non-infused. Edibles are foods or confections containing cannabis and can take longer to be felt than inhaled products.
blocks.sourceTitle: Your First Time at a Brooklyn Dispensary: What to Expect

blocks.html: Not sure? Our budtenders will walk you through each option and help you pick the format that fits your lifestyle.
blocks.sourceTitle: Your First Cannabis Purchase: Buzzy’s Guide to Feeling Confident, Curious & Completely At Ease

sections.heading: How many grams in an eighth

blocks.html: Let’s get straight to the point: an eighth of cannabis is 3.5 grams.
blocks.sourceTitle: How Many Grams in an Eighth

blocks.html: Every regulated package carries the same kinds of information. These are the parts BUZZY points to first.
Regulated adult-use cannabis products sold through licensed New York dispensaries carry the state’s universal cannabis symbol.
blocks.sourceTitle: How to Read a New York Cannabis Label

blocks.html: For anything portioned into servings, pay close attention to the difference between one serving and the entire container. A package containing multiple servings is not necessarily intended to be consumed all at once.
blocks.sourceTitle: How to Read a New York Cannabis Label

blocks.html: The Golden Rule of Dosing Edibles: Start Low, Go Slow
blocks.sourceTitle: How to Dose Edibles Safely A Beginner’s Guide

blocks.html: If you are new to a product, follow the label directions and give the product adequate time before considering more. Ingested cannabis can take longer to be felt than inhaled cannabis, and individual response varies.
blocks.sourceTitle: How to Read a New York Cannabis Label

blocks.html: Two terms show up on almost every label. BUZZY explains them like this.
The THCA it contains just doesn’t have the right key to unlock the psychoactive feelings we associate with cannabis. The real change happens when you add a little heat.
blocks.sourceTitle: THCA vs. THC: Understanding the Differences and Effects

blocks.html: They’re the aromatic compounds that give cannabis its signature scent.
blocks.sourceTitle: 👃 The Buzzy Terpene Guide: Understanding the Aromas, Effects & Science Behind Your Cannabis Experience
